expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Two nights at Sa Pa rather than one makes the difference. You get the village walk and the summit without rushing either.
expert.tip: Go up Fansipan early. The cloud usually builds by late morning and the summit disappears into it.

summary: A week in the north at an easy pace: a night in Hanoi, two at Sa Pa for the terraces of Cat Cat village and the Fansipan cable car, a night back in the city, then an overnight cruise among the limestone islands of Halong Bay.
included: Included: 6 nights with breakfast and dinner at the hotels, one of them on a cruise boat with lunch and dinner; private transfers throughout; a half day walk to Cat Cat village; the Fansipan mountain tour with the cable car; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
